boundary_definitions.exterior_frontier: {v not in C: at least one of v-d_k is in C}
boundary_definitions.occupied_boundary: {u in C: at least one of u+d_k is not in C}
boundary_definitions.post_removal_frontier: frontier(C\{u}) evaluated before v is added

centroid.definition: g(C)=(1/N) sum_{x in C} x in the declared affine lattice realization

D1_LOCAL_BOUNDARY_SLIDE.destination: empty nearest-neighbor v=u+d_k that belongs to frontier(C\{u})
D1_LOCAL_BOUNDARY_SLIDE.source: occupied boundary u of current C

D2_GLOBAL_BOUNDARY_RELOCATION_REFERENCE.classification: nonlocal relocation reference; never relabel as local slide
D2_GLOBAL_BOUNDARY_RELOCATION_REFERENCE.destination: any v in frontier(C\{u}) with v not in original C and v != u
D2_GLOBAL_BOUNDARY_RELOCATION_REFERENCE.source: occupied boundary u of current C

semantic_typing.external_disk_hexagon_models: N3_CONTINUUM_CLASSICAL; forbidden until post-ledger/post-holdout comparison stage
semantic_typing.native_claim_policy: No centroid, Euclidean metric, quadratic gravity, disk, or hexagon is promoted to N0-native by this task.
semantic_typing.occupancy_and_nearest_neighbor_adjacency: task-declared base relational substrate for R055

state_predicate.connected: all occupied sites form one component under the six nearest-neighbor directions
state_predicate.hole_free: Within the axial bounding box of C padded by 1 in each coordinate, flood-fill empty sites from every empty site on the padded-box boundary using the same six-neighbor adjacency. C is hole-free iff every empty site in the unpadded bounding box is exterior-reachable. This finite test is translation-invariant and exactly detects finite empty components for finite C.
state_predicate.orientation_metadata: retained for orientation-sensitive alternative tie-break diagnostics

accepted_move_postconditions_order: recompute centroid from all N cells
step_semantics.candidate_recomputation: recompute legal move set from scratch after every accepted move
step_semantics.selection: steepest strict descent: first minimize G(C_prime), then apply frozen tie-break
step_semantics.stopping_condition: no legal strict-descending move exists under the selected dynamics
